title: Conversation starters for a phone-free dinner

slides.text: What *small thing* made you happy this week?
If we had a *free year*, what would we do?
What’s a skill you *wish* you had?
What’s the *best advice* you’ve ever gotten?
What have you *changed your mind* about lately?

slides.title: Save this *for dinner tonight.*
slides.sub: Phones in another room. Cookies optional.
